verdict.rationale: First-party install docs say Meilisearch can be installed 'from source', so the source is available. Community reports of active GitHub contributors and of running the core engine (Milli) locally support that the codebase is publicly accessible. No evidence names the license or confirms it is an open-source license. Missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g., MIT or another OSI license), a link to the public source repository, and first-party documentation of the open-source licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Install Meilisearch locally on Linux, macOS, or Windows using cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT, or from source.
They praised active contributors on GitHub and Discord.
